name: Garlic Paprika Chicken Drumsticks with Avocado, Tomato & Greens Salad
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500°F. Line a baking dish with foil.
Peel and mince or press the garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Add lime juice, olive oil, paprika, salt, and pepper to the minced garlic and mix well.
Add the chicken drumsticks to the garlic-paprika mixture and toss until well coated. Place the drumsticks in the baking dish.
Place the drumsticks in the oven and bake, flipping halfway through cooking time, until they are cooked through and browned, 25-30 minutes.
In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together lime juice, olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
Wash and dry the mixed greens.
Halve and pit the avocados; scoop out the flesh and medium dice.
To serve, arrange the greens on plates, top with tomatoes and avocado, and drizzle with the dressing. Add chicken drumsticks to the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
